generalProcedure.method: read Figures 3.10.2.1-1 through 3.10.2.1-3 and linearly interpolate between contours or local extrema

implementedCoverage.scope: the 32 departmental capitals labeled on the three official national hazard maps
implementedCoverage.lookup: reviewed transcription at each labeled capital marker
implementedCoverage.notSupported: arbitrary coordinates, addresses, municipalities not included in the reviewed capital list, and project-specific special maps

reason: The official PDF maps are the normative source even though the archive has no machine-readable locality table. This implementation exposes only the finite set of 32 labeled departmental capitals whose PGA, Ss and S1 values were transcribed and reviewed from all three figures; it makes no GIS or arbitrary-location claim.
requiredResolutionForAdditionalLocations: Add a separately reviewed map transcription or an approved project-specific value source with provenance before exposing another location.
